## Situation

The governance-gate design has three candidate shapes and the loop cannot pick
one without a ruling. Work is parked at `implemented` until it is answered.

## Options

**Option A: ship the narrow gate.** Only the two gates already exercised are
enforced; the rest stay advisory.
Pros: lands this week; nothing new to review.
Cons: the advisory half rots, which is the failure this brief exists to stop.

**Option B: enforce all six.** Every gate is load-bearing from day one.
Pros: no advisory tier to rot.
Cons: two gates have no positive control yet, so they would ship unproven.

## What happens on each answer

| Answer | Effect |
|--------|--------|
| Option A | brief proceeds; a follow-on brief owns the other four gates |
| Option B | brief holds until the two missing positive controls exist |
